about: Two tools report the same issue. They must become one vulnerability (not two to triage), and agreement only counts as corroboration when at least one tool logged in.

cases.why: Nessus (credentialed) and Qualys (potential) on the same host and CVE: one vulnerability; the credentialed evidence wins.

findings.title: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS : OpenSSH vulnerabilities (USN-0003-1)

cases.why: Two tools, neither logged in: both may be reading the same banner, so it isn't corroboration.

cases.why: One tool's check contradicts the host OS; the other observed it with a login. Findings disagree: a person decides, never an automatic 'FP'.
